clauses.reason: Section 1 establishes the Advisory Committee on the Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters, of not more than 15 members appointed by the President from the private sector. Terminated by express revocation. Section 3 of Executive Order 13138, signed September 30, 1999, ends its lead-in with "committees that have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked:"; item (b) reads "Executive Order 13038, establishing the Advisory Committee on Public". Section 9 reads "Sec. 9. This order shall be effective September 30, 1999.", so the end is dated 1999-09-30, the stated effective date. The item continues on the following lines through the amending orders; it names Executive Order 13038 and the Advisory Committee on the Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters.  Later events: section 5 of Executive Order 13062 (effective 1997-09-30) changes the cap from 15 to 22 and Executive Order 13065 (signed 1997-10-22) changes it to up to 25 and adds Co-Chairs; the clause continues, amended.

Section 2 directs the Committee, on or before June 1, 1998, to report on the public interest obligations of digital television broadcasters. That is a report deadline, not an end. Terminated by express revocation. The item continues on the following lines through the amending orders; it names Executive Order 13038 and the Advisory Committee on the Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters.  Later events: Executive Order 13081 (signed 1998-04-30) changes June 1, 1998 to October 1, 1998 and Executive Order 13102 (signed 1998-09-25) changes October 1, 1998 to December 31, 1998; report dates, not ends.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 13038 (62 FR 12065, PDF pages 1-2 of the 1997-03-13 issue; sha256 7ccc89f5...), headed Executive Order 13038 of March 11, 1997, Advisory Committee on Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters, matching the census register row (1997-03-11). Text and inventory: eight scopes cover sections 1 through 4 to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory committee. Ending: Executive Order 13138 section 3(b) revokes Executive Order 13038 as amended, effective September 30, 1999 (section 9). The report date of section 2 (moved three times) and the report-relative termination in section 4 are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 13138 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the Advisory Committee on Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters: its continuance sections concern other committees and its revocation section revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the body.
